training.checkpoint_rule: Final fixed step only; no early stopping, tuning or refit from diagnostics/test results.
training.loss: Variant-specific, exactly as loss_variants; reference anchor remains0.1

primary_metric: Equal-category then equal-six-shift macro pixel AP within each paired seed. Differences are formed at category/seed/condition before aggregation.

category_change_rule.metric: six-shift macro pixel AP difference, averaged over paired seeds
category_change_rule.interpretation: Predeclared practical reporting threshold; not a significance test.

architecture.implementation: Unchanged src.defect_adapter.DefectAdapter; identical initialization per seed across A1,L1,L2.

split_rule: Filter shots==16 from the frozen capacity splits.json; preserve all45 reference/fit/diagnostic lists and their exact order. No new sampling or new data.

L2.teacher: Frozen normalized DINOv2 clean feature z; not stopgrad(h(z)).

diagnostics.images: Only the original four diagnostic normal images; never used for fitting, checkpoint selection or hyperparameter selection.
diagnostics.conditions: The same four training photometric conditions, applied to held-out diagnostic normal images.

adoption_gates.interpretation: Preregistered practical adoption criteria, not statistical significance. Report both candidates and every failure; no additional variants or tuning after test results.

visualization_rule.selection: Reuse the exact frozen capacity visualization selection: first lexicographically ordered defective test path per category.
visualization_rule.scale: Per case and condition, common zero to pooled-all-four-method 99th percentile. Values above the maximum saturate. No per-method rescaling.
visualization_rule.interpretation: Fixed illustrative cases only; not a substitute for full paired localization metrics.

scope: Stage3: exactly two loss variants at frozen MLP32/16shot architecture and data budget, all15 categories; no capacity/CNN/data/backbone changes.
restrictions: Freeze existing A0,A1,paper,capacity/CNN code and all results. Work only on independent codex/a1-loss-study branch with new result paths.
Use existing Windows venv and RTX4060, frozen DINOv2-S/14 384D weights, unchanged feature/preprocessing/reference rotations/normalization/search/image scoring/localization processing.
For each category and paired seed use exact old12 fitting normals,4 diagnostic normals,all16 references. Do not mix categories.
Preserve1000finalsteps,AdamW lr.001 wd.0001,512effective centers,4illumination transforms and exact old center schedule. A1/L1/L2 share initialization.
L1 changes only anchor coefficient .1 to .2. L2 changes only illumination target to frozen z.detach(), keeping anchor .1. No synthesized defect or extra loss.
No test/real-defect labels for training,tuning,early stopping or checkpoint selection. Finish all90 new final heads before any L1/L2 test evaluation.
Reuse existing normal feature caches after hash/provenance checks. No new data or replacement of existing cache files.
Require source/config/data/split/cache/checkpoint/init/schedule identity checks and exact full1260 metric/pairing audit; retain all failed attempts and retries.
Report full15,original3 and prior12 separately; all categories were previously evaluated and none form a new unseen validation set.
Equalcategory/equalcondition macro; form differences within category/seed/condition. Three seeds share one testset and do not establish statistical significance.
Save all planned outcomes,including loss increases and regressions. Practical gates do not authorize additional trials,losses or hyperparameter tuning.
Publish code/config/smallresults/analysis only; exclude datasets,large feature caches and pretrained weights.
